name: Non-cryptostigmatic mites
description: Fungus-grazing soil mites other than the oribatids (e.g. prostigmatic and astigmatic mites), feeding on saprophytic and mycorrhizal fungi. Functional group aggregating the non-cryptostigmatic mite species, measured together by the source. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is in kg C per hectare, yearly average, from Table A1 of van Altena et al. 2016.
